notes.title: The New Achievement Update!
notes.notes:
Main features:

- 5 new in-game achievements

- Changes to the menu

As of now, there are only five achievements. Not to worry, we will be adding in more in future updates. That's all for now!

notes.title: The New Menu Update!
notes.notes:
We've decided to roll out a small menu and graphics update.

This includes:

-New game shading (Prevents black shadows)

-Improved menu design

 This is an important one! You will notice the "assign controller " and "pixelation" buttons have both been removed from the main menu. As of the current version of Stop Cats, there is no current controller support. This will be a future feature but for now there is no use for the button. But fear not, the pixelation setting can still be toggled in the main menu. Now it is located in the arrow menu (visit the main menu for context.)

- Finally, the main menu has also been re-shaded

Other than that we thank you for reading the new Stop Cats notes.

Have a fantastic day!
